intro: A Soran'ruk Fragment is a shattered shard of a demonic prison orb once bound to the spirit of a disgraced servant of the Burning Legion. Though split and dispersed among cultists deep beneath Ashenvale, each shard still radiates residual fel energy.

p: When demons of the Burning Legion fall out of favor with their masters, their spirits are sometimes condemned to imprisonment inside specialized orbs and distributed to fel spellcasters as conduits of raw power. The orb of Soran'ruk met this fate, yet somewhere in its history, it was cracked apart. One half was broken into smaller shards and fell into the hands of the Twilight's Hammer cultists lurking within the submerged ruins of Blackfathom Deeps, who draw upon the lingering demonic essence for their own dark workings.
